description: Compute a Subresource Integrity (SRI) hash for a script or stylesheet's content: digest it with SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 and return each as the `<algorithm>-<base64>` string an HTML `integrity` attribute expects. Returns all three algorithms at once.

content.description: The exact file/script content to hash, byte-for-byte

name: generate_sri_hash
